video_title: LeBron on Why The Knicks Won't Be Content After Winning the Title

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: The New York Knicks' championship season and in-season tournament victory
quotes.excerpt: They have a group of guys that when there's something on the table, they want it.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Let's talk about what I would call the main story. Let's start with the Knicks. They are the defending champs, they earned the respect. They also won the in-season tournament. They have a group of guys that when there's something on the table, they want it. They go after it, they fight.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: They got a bunch of guys that compete and they got winners.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's evolution and buy-in to the Knicks' offensive system
quotes.excerpt: He not only bought in, played off the hub, their offense became a little more egalitarian.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: You remember early in the year, Jalen Brunson made a comment about not being sure what I'm doing in this offense. But by the end of the year, he not only bought in, played off the hub, their offense became a little more egalitarian, a little less predictable, and he defended.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: And that goes back to episode one about trial and error. He had some trial and error. He was out there like I'm a blind bat right now. I don't know what I'm doing. I'm just out here. I trail, shoot my three off the trail spot, I may get a post up. I don't know what I'm doing. And they had that trial and error run and we saw what happened from the moment obviously when he said that to them hosting the Larry O'Brien trophy.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's emphasis on competition and Jalen Brunson's leadership
quotes.excerpt: One thing about Mike Brown's teams, and I played for coach for my years, my early days in Cleveland, one thing he always just talked about was competing.
quotes.quote: One thing about Mike Brown's teams, and I played for coach for my years, my early days in Cleveland, one thing he always just talked about was competing. Let's compete. Let's compete, let's compete. And they got guys that played the right way. We always talk about how our high praise for Josh Hart. Jalen Brunson, we talk questions about can a small guard, having been one myself and not been able to get over the hump, he got his team over the line. Clutch moments, leadership, guarded his yard the best he could, never made excuses, never cut corners.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby's impact as the Knicks' most steady player in the finals
quotes.excerpt: OG was I think was the MVP of the of the team in the finals.
quotes.quote: I mean obviously we seen OG. OG was I think was the MVP of the of the team in the finals. And obviously Jalen Brunson became the MVP, but it's the small things. The chase down block on Fox, the tip for the game. He was consistent, the continue to knock down threes. And his numbers from day one of the playoffs through was incredible in those pivotal moments.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' roster changes and the addition of Andre Drummond and Bruce Brown
quotes.excerpt: They replaced him with Andre Drummond and Bruce Brown. I coached Bruce Brown, winner, tough.
quotes.quote: They lost Mitchell Robinson, a big piece, underrated, under-heralded to those maybe casual fans, but elite elite offensive rebounder, elite elite rim protector, controls the paint, just a great card to be able to pitch, to be able to throw. He goes to Boston, so that is tough. They replace him with Andre Drummond and Bruce Brown. I coached Bruce Brown, winner, tough, won a championship in Denver, just a really tough, combative guard who can play multiple positions, play up. And Andre, Andre is still an athletic guy who can move and always been an unbelievable rebounder too.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' humble culture and expectation of continued success
quotes.excerpt: They don't have many guys that that gives me entitled. Like oh we won, so we expect to win.
quotes.quote: They don't have many guys that that gives me entitled. Like oh we won, so we expect to win. They they give me guys who like okay, humble guys. Let's go back to work again. So they'll be they'll be right back there.
